plugins.name: shipwright
plugins.description: Production-grade shipping pipeline: audit → review → docs → PR

skills.name: audit-full
skills.description: Branch-aware audit orchestrator. On main — scans whole project, opens tracker issue. On feature branch — scopes to diff, auto-fixes, stages changes.
skills.description_zh: 按分支决定审查范围：在 main 扫描整个项目并创建跟踪 issue；在功能分支限定差异范围，自动修复并暂存修改。

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces. Rejects generic AI aesthetics (purple gradients, Inter font, glassmorphism). Design direction first, then implementation.
skills.description_zh: 先确定设计方向，再实现具有辨识度的生产级前端界面。原说明明确排斥紫色渐变、Inter 字体和玻璃拟态等泛化 AI 风格。

skills.name: merge-pr
skills.description: Merge current PR after CI passes. Waits for all checks, squash merges, deletes branch, switches to main.
skills.description_zh: 等待当前 PR 的所有 CI 检查通过后 squash 合并，删除分支并切回 main。

skills.name: parallel-builder
skills.description: Build multiple files/pages in parallel using subagents. Handles task division, shared file coordination, and build verification. Conflict-free by design.
skills.description_zh: 通过子智能体并行开发多个文件或页面，负责任务拆分、共享文件协调和构建验证；避免冲突属于原说明的设计目标。

skills.name: push
skills.description: Smart commit + push + auto-create PR. Blocks push to main. Runs pre-flight gate checks before pushing.
skills.description_zh: 执行提交、推送及自动创建 PR，推送前运行预检关卡，并阻止直接推送 main。

skills.name: review-code-fix
skills.description: Automated code review → fix → re-review loop. Runs until score >9 or max 3 rounds. Fixes Critical/Major/Warnings only — Suggestions are deferred.
skills.name_hint: 评审 · 代码 · 修复
skills.description_zh: 自动循环执行代码评审、修复和再评审，直至评分超过 9 或最多三轮；只修复严重、主要及警告项，建议项暂缓。

skills.name: review-docs
skills.description: Verify Phase D doc updates are accurate. Binary pass/fail gate — checks stat accuracy, file path validity, code-doc sync, completeness. Runs after /update-docs.
headings: Example — replace with your project's tools
skills.description_zh: 在 /update-docs 后验证 Phase D 文档更新，以通过或失败判断统计准确性、路径有效性、代码文档同步及完整性。

skills.name: review-full
skills.description: Smart review dispatcher. Auto-detects scope from diff (frontend/backend/docs/both), runs the right fix loops until all gates pass. Used as Phase R entry point in /ship.
skills.description_zh: 依据差异自动识别前端、后端、文档或混合范围，分派对应修复循环直到全部关卡通过；作为 /ship 的 Phase R 评审入口。

skills.name: review-ux-fix
skills.description: Automated UX review → fix → re-review loop. Target is perfection (10/10). Fixes ALL severities including Suggestions — because UX polish compounds.
skills.description_zh: 自动循环执行 UX 评审、修复和再评审，以 10/10 为目标，处理包括建议在内的全部严重等级。

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Full pipeline — audit, review+fix, docs, push PR. One command to go from "done coding" to "PR ready for review." Does NOT deploy — your CI/CD handles that after merge.
skills.description_zh: 串联审查、评审修复、文档更新和推送 PR，将编码完成推进到可评审的 PR。该流程不部署，合并后的部署由 CI/CD 处理。

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Meta-skill that teaches how to create effective Claude Code skills. Covers anatomy, progressive disclosure, validation, and packaging.
skills.description_zh: 指导创建有效的 Claude Code 技能，涵盖结构组成、渐进式信息披露、验证和打包。

skills.name: update-docs
skills.description: Sync documentation with code changes. Auto-detects scope from git diff, updates tier 1-4 docs (core, architecture, journey, config), verifies stats. Phase D of /ship pipeline.
headings: Example — replace with your project's tool
Components, endpoints, tests — adjust globs to your structure
skills.description_zh: 依据 Git 差异自动识别范围，将代码变化同步到核心、架构、用户旅程及配置四级文档，并验证统计数据；属于 /ship 流程的 Phase D。
